data.notes: Confirmed November 2026 Tulum programming is still sparse; the strongest verified listings are cultural/party formats rather than full club-season lineups.

events.title: PPP Presents - UMBRAL Dia de Muertos
events.summary: UMBRAL is a contemporary Day of the Dead celebration at Papaya Playa Project, with ritual, culture, community programming and a Saturday night celebration featuring international DJs. The event page lists the program as taking place October 25 to November 2, overlapping the first days of November.

events.title: Tulum Crypto Fest 2026
events.summary: Tulum Crypto Fest is a four-day culture-and-networking conference with confirmed festival parties, an opening party and a November 28 Full Moon Party described as a music-focused celebration. No artist lineup is listed yet on the ticket page.
